newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PBG net doubles to PLN 115 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish PBG net doubles to PLN 115 mln in 1996.

text.p: The net profit of Poland's Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA (PBG), part of the banking group formed around Pekao SA, soared to 115.3 million zlotys in 1996 from 50.7 million in 1995, PBG said in a Wednesday statement.
PBG's gross profit increased to 173.2 million zlotys last year from 115.8 million in 1995.
PBG alocated 82.3 million zlotys of its 1996 profit to reserve captial and 9.2 million as dividend.
Last year the bank's own funds increased 17.5 percent and amounted to 280.9 million zlotys.
From last September state-owned bank Pekao SA is the sole owner of PBG.
